LuaFunction.Name: NOBN_sig_getCabinetName()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns a string for each cabinet variant. Keylock cabinets receive a code based on the object's OCP area and the 'Seq' property.
LuaFunction.Formula: function NOBN_sig_getCabinetName() if string.find(Variant, "signalling cabinet") then return "As."..code elseif string.find(Variant, "Key lock") then local v = "Arbeidsområde" local n, a n, a = RC__getAreasOfVariant(v) if n == 1 then return "Klck."..NOBN_com_getOcpCode().." "..a[0].code.."-"..Seq else return "*** Zero or multiple ("..n..") areas found of Variant '"..v.."' - cannot deduce a unique name for keylock cabinet." end elseif string.find(Variant, "Crank") then return "Cr."..code elseif string.find(Variant, "Cable") then return "Kabelboks "..code else return "Unknown variant",_warning end end

LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_SSP_Geometry3DName() --Ignore the DerailerState property - always draw the derailer in its derailing state. local t = "NO-BN-3D-SA-SSP-SPORSPERRE" if Variant:lower():match("single") then t = t.."-ENKEL" elseif Variant:lower():match("double") then t = t.."-DOBBEL" else t = t.."-BAD_Variant" end if derailSide == 'left' then t = t.."-VSIDE" elseif derailSide == 'right' then t = t.."-VSIDE" else t = t.."-BAD_derailSide" end return t end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_TEL_code()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns a text string 'DownSection/UpSection' for an axle counter sensor.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_TEL_code() local first = "-" local shortestDistanceSoFar = math.huge for i = 0, DownSections.Count-1 do local obj = DownSections[i] if obj and obj:isVisible() then local dist = getDistance(obj) if dist < shortestDistanceSoFar then first = DownSections[i].code shortestDistanceSoFar = dist end end end local second = "-" shortestDistanceSoFar = math.huge for i = 0, UpSections.Count-1 do local obj = UpSections[i] if obj and obj:isVisible() then local dist = getDistance(obj) if dist < shortestDistanceSoFar then second = UpSections[i].code shortestDistanceSoFar = dist end end end if MileageIncreasesTowardsLeft then first, second = second, first end if first == "-" and second == "-" then return first.."/"..second, _info("UNFINISHED - Create axle counter Section object(s) to obtain the section numbers 'a/b' for the sensor.") else return first.."/"..second end end

LuaFunction.Name: NOBN_sig_chkTriggerNeighbourIsolatedJoints()
LuaFunction.Description: Triggers modelchecking in neighbour isolated joints.
LuaFunction.Formula: function NOBN_sig_chkTriggerNeighbourIsolatedJoints() if Alignment == nil then return "UNFINISHED - Missing own alignment.",_error end local n = 0 local t = {} local prev = getDownObject(rctype_InsulatedRailJoint) if prev then n = n + 1 table.insert(t, prev) end local next = getUpObject(rctype_InsulatedRailJoint) if next then n = n + 1 table.insert(t, next) end return n, t, _info(n.." isolated joints have been modelchecked.") end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_DRV_code()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the code for a point machine, derived from the switch it is related to with '"..rel_PointMachine_BelongsTo_Switch.."'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_DRV_code() local s, r, n, sw, pm, nPm, i, j, d s = rel_PointMachine_BelongsTo_Switch r, n = getRelatedObjects(s) if n == 0 then return "Relate with '"..s.."' to switch object (turnout).", _info("Point machines derive their code from the switch they are related to with '"..s.."'.") else sw = r[0] pm, nPm = getRelatedObjects(rel_Switch_Has_PointMachine, sw) j = 0 for i = 0, nPm-1 do d = (sw.dir == "up") and 1 or -1 if ((ReferenceMileage - pm[i].ReferenceMileage)*d >= 0) then j = j + 1 end end return tonumber(sw.code) and string.format("%d.%d",sw.code, j) or string.format("%s.%d",sw.code, j) end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_DRV_dir()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the direction (dir) for a point machine, derived from the switch it is related to with '"..rel_PointMachine_BelongsTo_Switch.."'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_DRV_dir() local s, sw, n s = rel_PointMachine_BelongsTo_Switch sw, n = getRelatedObjects(s) if n == 0 then return "unknown", _info("Point machines derive their direction from the switch they are related to with '"..s.."'.") else return sw[0].dir end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_DRV_Geometry3DName()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the 3D geometry's 'Name' for a point machine, derived from its Variant, direction (dir) and side of alignment (distanceToAlignment).
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_DRV_Geometry3DName() local t = "" if Variant == "Unspecified" then return "NO-BN-3D-FE-DIV-UKJENT" elseif Variant == "Alstom MET" then t = "NO-BN-3D-SA-DRV-SPORVEKSELDRIVMASKIN-ALSTOM-MET-" elseif Variant == "Siemens Bsg9" then t = "NO-BN-3D-SA-DRV-SPORVEKSELDRIVMASKIN-SIEMENS-BSG9-" elseif Variant == "Siemens ELS 710" then t = "NO-BN-3D-SA-DRV-SPORVEKSELDRIVMASKIN-SIEMENS-ELS710-" else return "NO-BN-3D-FE-DIV-UKJENT",_error, _info("Unrecognized variant ["..Variant.."].") end if ((dir == "up" and RightSided) or (dir == "down" and LeftSided)) then return t.."HSIDE" elseif ((dir == "up" and LeftSided) or (dir == "down" and RightSided)) then return t.."VSIDE" else return "Cannot determine side of track for point machine.",_error end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_LOK_code()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the code for a local control panel, derived from the switch or derailer it is related to with '"..rel_LocalControlPanel_Actuates_SwitchOrDerailer.."'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_LOK_code() local s = rel_LocalControlPanel_Actuates_SwitchOrDerailer local r, n = getRelatedObjects(s) if n == 0 then return "UNFINISHED - Missing relation '"..s.."' to switch object or derailer object.",_warning, _info("A local control panel derives its code property from the switch or derailer which it is related to.") elseif n == 1 then if r[0].RcType == rctype_Switch then local coupledSwitch, ncsw = getRelatedObjects(rel_Switch_IsCoupledWith_Switch, r[0]) if ncsw == 0 then return r[0].code else return coupledSwitch[0].code.."/"..r[0].code end elseif r[0].RcType == rctype_Derailer then return r[0].code else return "ERROR - Bad RcType ["..r[0].RcType.."] for object related to Local control panel.",_error end else return "ERROR - More than 1 ["..n.."] object related to Local control panel.",_error end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_LOK_dir()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the dir (direction) for a local control panel, derived from the switch or derailer it is related to with '"..rel_LocalControlPanel_Actuates_SwitchOrDerailer.."'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_LOK_dir() local s = rel_LocalControlPanel_Actuates_SwitchOrDerailer local r, n = getRelatedObjects(s) if n == 0 then return "unknown" else if r[0].RcType == rctype_LocalControlPanel then return "both" else return r[0].dir end end end
